entities.name: Luboš Pospíšil
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luboš Pospíšil is a Czech singer-songwriter and guitarist, and the frontman of the pop-rock band 5P. In 1969, he was a founding member of C&K Vocal, and since he left the band, he has released twelve solo albums. Between 1988 and 1990, he was a member of Blue Effect.
